title_sq: Ne Bllok, Prane Cafe Roma, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 I Pershtatshem Per Tu Ndare Ne 3 Apartamente !
description_sq: Ne Bllok, Prane Cafe Roma, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 I Pershtatshem Per Tu Ndare Ne 3 Apartamente. Apartamenti pervecse eshte i pershtatshem per banim gjithashtu eshte nje mundesi e mire per ndarje ne 3 apartamente nga te cilat 2 garsoniere dhe apartament 1+1 duke marr parasysh zonen me nje kerkese te larte per apartamente me qira ditore. Zona ku ndodhet eshte nga me te mirat dhe te preferuara ne Tirane per nje cilesi te larte jetese. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In the block, near Cafe Roma, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, suitable to be divided into 3 apartments!
description_en: In the block, near Cafe Roma, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, suitable to be divided into 3 apartments. The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a well-managed building with a total area of ​​139 m2 and is organized by a corridor that divides the large living room together with a kitchenette with access to the balcony, a matrimonial room with a dedicated toilet and access to the balcony, a children's room and another toilet. Apart from being suitable for living, the apartment is also a good opportunity to divide into 3 apartments, of which 2 studios and 1+1 apartment, considering the area with a high demand for apartments for daily rent. The area where it is located is one of the best and preferred in Tirana for a high quality of life. The property has full mortgage documentation.
